QuestInfo.name: Gaga's Crayon
QuestInfo.1:
Cassandra, who loves to draw but isn't very good at it, wants you to complete her rainbow drawing. Gaga has the 7 crayons you need, but if you tell him that you need it for Cassandra, he might not give them to you. 

Also, the color of the crayon you can borrow is different each day of the week. 
#b
- Monday: Red
- Tuesday: Orange
- Wednesday: Yellow
- Thursday: Green
- Friday: Blue
- Saturday: Indigo
- Sunday: Violet
#r* On  April 17 and May 2, you can borrow any color that you want.

0.0: If you want a crayon... Take this pot and bring it back to me once the flower blooms. A small yellow flower will bloom if you take good care of it for a fixed period of time.

yes.0: I really want to see a yellow flower, you hear?

no.0: I thought you needed a crayon. You won't be able to complete the picture without helping me first.

1.0: Yes! That's the flower I wanted to see! I will give you the crayon that you want for today. Go ahead and choose which one you'd like.

yes.0: How much of the picture have you completed?

item.0: Has the flower not bloomed yet? You haven't lost the flower pot right?
